delivery_policy.blocker: Current GitHub connector exposes no repository-creation action. Browser fallback requires user approval.
delivery_policy.uk_data_policy: Use actual free public UK sector data. State geography, capture time, observation/publication dates, cadence, licence and mode. Never label a monthly release as real-time. No invented training or silent live-data fallback.
